hints.title: Digit Sum Invariant
hints.text: Adding positive numbers decreases the digit sum only when a carry resets trailing non-zero digits to zero.

hints.title: Low-to-High Rounding
hints.text: Round up the number to the nearest power of 10 from right to left to eliminate digits that push the sum above target.

hints.title: Iterative Carry Generation
hints.text: At each step, if digit sum exceeds target, round up to the next multiple of 10, 100, 1000, etc., until the sum fits within target.

hints.title: Iterative Base Rounding Implementation

variables: d: number of digits in n
complexity.notes: There are at most 18 decimal digits; each round takes O(d) steps to evaluate the digit sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incrementing one by one until the digit sum matches target can loop over 10^12 times.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(d) space to convert integers to decimal strings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Realizes that carries zero out trailing digits and minimizes addition by rounding lowest digits first.
